verdict.rationale: Airbyte documents a programmatic API ("Use the Airbyte API to programmatically interact with Airbyte"), but nothing in the evidence shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec. The probe found every candidate OpenAPI/Swagger path returned 404. An llms.txt file exists, but that is a docs index, not a machine-readable API spec, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
